messages:
maria: Customer report — hosted API returning bursts of 502/504 for long inference requests since ~09:15 UTC. High latency spikes observed at edge -> midproxy. Sample trace id: trace-7f9c2a. Can someone triage?
ben: looking. any repro request or curl we can run?
maria: customer sent a minimal repro payload (large prompt + streaming). They see 504 then retry -> 502 on retries. Happens ~30-60s into stream.
anya: quick glance at edge logs: envoy shows upstream_request_timeout -> 504 at 09:15:41 for trace-7f9c2a, then soon after 502 from midproxy when it returns truncated body. payload sizes ~1.2MB.
mike: trying to reproduce locally against staging frontdoor. curl they used: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"gpt-4-small","input":"<~1MB prompt here>","stream":true}'
```
results: on staging I see keepalive resets and then a 504 from ingress after ~30s.
irene: two quick signals we saw historically: 1) upstream connection window exhaustion on long streaming requests, 2) midproxy sometimes ejects backend when tail latency spikes leading to 502 when retries hit a bad host.
ben: pulled traces from trace-7f9c2a: midproxy logs show a 200 from modelpool but then connection reset while streaming body to ingress; midproxy had a subsequent reconnect attempt that returned 502 while upstream was ejected from RLB for slow responses.
maria: customer is on hosted tier, wants a timeline and workaround. They reported this caused 4% of their requests to fail during spike.
anya: immediate mitigation idea: bump envoy upstream_read_timeout for streaming routes to 75s and enable conservative retry on 502 for streaming non-idempotent parts (with max retries=1). Also enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts to reduce stream length.
mike: can we test timeout change in eu1-staging? I'll flip a config for one frontdoor and run the curl for 1 hour.
irene: also recommend adding a short-term midproxy rollout to reduce RLB ejection aggressiveness (increase host failure threshold). That prevents cascade where one slow host triggers 502s on retries.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: config-change/timeouts -> eu1-staging at 10:05 UTC (id: deploy-7832).
ben: after replaying ~200 long-stream requests against modified eu1-staging, observed 504 -> reduced to <0.5% and 502s disappeared for same payloads. Will keep load test running.
maria: passing this to support ticket #T-4432 with workaround steps and ETA for org-wide rollout. Customer notified. :thumbsup:
anya: follow-up: need a PR to make new timeout setting configurable per-route in console and a note in Runbook (edge timeouts section). I'll file issues.
mike: notes for postmortem: capture RLB ejection thresholds, keepalive/connwindow metrics, and streaming response body resets. Also consider streaming backpressure metrics on modelpool.
maria: thanks team. I'll close loop with customer after stable rollout and include curl repro and mitigation steps.
